items.title: Appear as witness at court hearing
items.computation: The letter prints a fixed calendar date and time for the hearing, not a period to be counted; the due date is simply that printed date.

warnings: This is a witness summons (Ladung) from a civil court, not a decision against the recipient; staying away without sufficient excuse can lead to costs and a Ordnungsgeld being imposed under § 380 ZPO, so the appointment itself should not be missed or rescheduled without informing the court.
Bring the summons itself and an official photo ID to the hearing as instructed ('Bringen Sie bitte diese Ladung und einen amtlichen Ausweis mit.').
